name: Trifluoromescaline
summary: Trifluoromescaline (TFM), also known as 4-(trifluoromethoxy)-3,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a derivative of the phenethylamine psychedelic mescaline, which has a 4-trifluoromethoxy group replacing the 4-methoxy group of mescaline.

pharmacology.text: The drug showed about 34-fold higher affinity and 36-fold greater activational potency at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor compared to mescaline in vitro.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen
